minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  MAY 12, 2014

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  May 12, 2014
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, May 27, 2014.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Members present: Peterson, Rubincam, Shaffer, Chooljian and
  Wade

  Members absent: None

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

None

CITIZEN APPLICATION

1.  PC-377-14; Application to remove 2 Aleppo pines located in the parkway
  adjacent to 1009 Granvia Altamira

  Applicant:  Sheri LaBreche
  1009 Granvia Altamira
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee Member Wade moved and Committee Member Rubincam
seconded to deny PC-377-14 to remove 2 Aleppo pines located in the parkway
adjacent to 1009 Granvia Altamira (5-0).

2.  PC-378-14; Application to remove 1 Silver Dollar Eucalyptus located in the
  parkway adjacent to 2629 Via Valdes

  Applicant:  Darin Toll
  2636 Via Valdes
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, May 27, 2014.
  Director approval  SR
 Action: Committee Member Chooljian moved and Committee Member Shaffer
seconded to approve PC-378-14 with modification to allow removal of the lower
branches to improve the view (per illustrated PowerPoint presentation) and direct
the Forester to return this item within one year to allow review by the Parklands
Committee (5-0).

3.  PC-379-14; Application to remove 1 Aleppo pine located in the Margate Road
  triangular median adjacent to 1620 Margate Road

  Applicant:  Clayton Smith
  1620 Margate Road
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee Member Rubincam moved and Committee Member Chooljian
seconded to approve PC-379-14 with modification to allow removal of lower
branches to improve the view (per illustrated PowerPoint presentation) and direct
the Forester to return this item within one year to allow review by the Parklands
Committee (5-0).

4.  PC-380-14; Application to remove 3 palm trees located in the Parklands adjacent
  to 1700 ½ Punta Place and 1 palm tree located adjacent to 1805 Via Visalia

  Applicant:  Angela Paik
  1700 Punta Place
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee Member Wade moved and Committee Member Chooljian
seconded to deny PC-380-14, the removal of 3 palm trees located in the Parklands
adjacent to 1700 ½ Punta Place and 1 palm tree located adjacent to 1805 Via
Visalia. (4-1, Rubincam dissenting).

OLD BUSINESS - None

NEW BUSINESS - None

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

5.  Parklands Use Policy - Reviewed and filed.

6.  Update on current Parklands Enhancement Projects - Reviewed and filed.

ADJOURNMENT TO JUNE 9, 2014

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, May 27, 2014.
  Director approval  SR
